correctness.rationale: Brownian first-hit Laplace transform e^{-y sqrt(s/D)} and gate generator semigroup yield exact K_y(s) and marked transition M(z)=diag((1+z)/2,1), giving normalized matrix renewal resolvent for s>0. Excursion hitting times have 1/2-stable sum: contact n tail exactly erfc((x+(n-1)epsilon)/(2sqrt(Dt))), so renewal contact number scaled by sqrt(t) is half-normal with uniform moment bounds. Gate chain at hits is irreducible with stationary open fraction p; independent open-side coins give asymptotic mark fraction p/2 pathwise. No-switch transform expansion gives invertible 2×2 matrix determinant p(1-k)/2 and distinct exact C_O,C_C; monotone Tauberian theorem yields t^{-1/2} and infinite mean. Independent symbolic proof checks determinant and exact C difference; finite tests only corroborate analytic steps. No epsilon→0 or bulk resetting claim.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks corroborate only their stated bounded domain; the universal claim depends on reconstructed analytic proof.
